context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 221 completed comprehensive testing of Tasks, Meetings, and Scheduling modules. All three modules working correctly with proper role-based access controls. Admin features visible and functional. Member sees only their own data (tasks assigned to them, meetings they're part of, polls they created). Responsive design working on Mobile (390x844), Tablet (768x1024), and Desktop (1920x1080). Backend API tests: 42/42 passed. Frontend UI tests: All passed. WebRTC/LiveKit in container has no camera/mic - MediaError banner expected in live meetings (not a bug). Welcome tour dialog appears for new users.
